definitions.deathtouch: Any amount of damage this deals to a creature is enough to destroy it.
definitions.double strike: This creature deals both first strike and regular combat damage.
definitions.enchant: Target the object or player it says to target. The enchantment enters attached to that target.
definitions.equip: Attach this Equipment to target creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
definitions.first strike: This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.
definitions.flash: You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant.
definitions.flying: This creature can only be blocked by creatures with flying or reach.
definitions.haste: This creature can attack and tap as soon as it comes under your control.
definitions.hexproof: This permanent can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.
definitions.indestructible: Effects that say 'destroy' don't destroy this permanent. A creature with indestructible can't be destroyed by damage.
definitions.lifelink: Damage dealt by this creature also causes you to gain that much life.
definitions.menace: This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.
definitions.prowess: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
definitions.reach: This creature can block creatures with flying.
definitions.trample: This creature can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
definitions.vigilance: Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap.
definitions.ward: Whenever this permanent becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays the ward cost.
definitions.protection: This permanent can't be damaged, enchanted, equipped, blocked, or targeted by anything with the stated quality.
definitions.shroud: This permanent can't be the target of spells or abilities.
definitions.regenerate: The next time this creature would be destroyed this turn, it isn't. Instead, tap it, remove all damage from it, and remove it from combat.
definitions.landwalk: This creature is unblockable as long as the defending player controls a land of the stated type.
definitions.banding: Any creatures with banding, and up to one without, can attack in a band. Bands are blocked as a group. If any creatures with banding you control are blocking or being blocked by a creature, you divide that creature's combat damage, not the defending player.
definitions.rampage: Whenever this creature becomes blocked, it gets +X/+X until end of turn for each creature blocking it beyond the first.
definitions.cumulative upkeep: At the beginning of your upkeep, put an age counter on this permanent, then sacrifice it unless you pay its upkeep cost for each age counter on it.
definitions.phasing: This permanent phases out just before you untap during your untap step. While it's phased out, it's treated as though it doesn't exist. It phases in just before you untap during your next untap step.
definitions.shadow: This creature can only block or be blocked by creatures with shadow.
definitions.flanking: Whenever a creature without flanking blocks this creature, the blocking creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
definitions.cycling: Pay the cycling cost and discard this card: Draw a card.
definitions.echo: At the beginning of your upkeep, if this came under your control since the beginning of your last upkeep, sacrifice it unless you pay its echo cost.
definitions.horsemanship: This creature can only be blocked by creatures with horsemanship.
definitions.fear: This creature can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and/or black creatures.
definitions.morph: You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for 3 mana. Turn it face up any time for its morph cost.
definitions.amplify: As this creature enters, put N +1/+1 counters on it for each card of the stated type you reveal from your hand.
definitions.provoke: When this creature attacks, you may have target creature defending player controls untap and block it if able.
definitions.storm: When you cast this spell, copy it for each spell cast before it this turn.
definitions.affinity: This spell costs 1 less to cast for each artifact you control.
definitions.entwine: Choose both if you pay the entwine cost.
definitions.modular: This creature enters with N +1/+1 counters on it. When it dies, you may put its +1/+1 counters on target artifact creature.
definitions.bushido: Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked, it gets +N/+N until end of turn.
definitions.soulshift: When this creature dies, you may return target Spirit card with converted mana cost N or less from your graveyard to your hand.
definitions.splice: As you cast an instant or sorcery spell, you may reveal this card from your hand and pay its splice cost. If you do, add this card's effects to that spell.
definitions.offering: You may cast this card any time you could cast an instant by sacrificing a creature of the stated type and paying the difference in mana costs between this and the sacrificed creature.
definitions.ninjutsu: Return an unblocked attacker you control to hand: Put this card onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
definitions.epic: For the rest of the game, you can't cast spells. At the beginning of each of your upkeeps, copy this spell except for its epic ability.
definitions.convoke: Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for 1 mana or one mana of that creature's color.
definitions.dredge: If you would draw a card, instead you may mill N cards and return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
definitions.transmute: Pay the transmute cost and discard this card: Search your library for a card with the same converted mana cost as this card, reveal it, and put it into your hand.
definitions.bloodthirst: If an opponent was dealt damage this turn, this creature enters with N +1/+1 counters on it.
definitions.haunt: When this card is put into a graveyard after being cast, exile it haunting target creature. When the creature it haunts dies, you may cast this card from exile without paying its mana cost.
definitions.replicate: When you cast this spell, copy it for each time you paid its replicate cost.
definitions.forecast: Reveal this card from your hand: [Effect]. Activate this ability only during your upkeep and only once each turn.
definitions.graft: This creature enters with N +1/+1 counters on it. Whenever another creature enters, you may move a +1/+1 counter from this creature to it.
definitions.recover: When a creature is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, you may pay the recover cost. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to your hand. Otherwise, exile this card.
definitions.ripple: When you cast this spell, you may reveal the top N cards of your library. You may cast spells with the same name as this spell from among those cards without paying their mana costs.
definitions.split second: As long as this spell is on the stack, players can't cast spells or activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.
definitions.suspend: Rather than cast this card from your hand, pay its suspend cost and exile it with N time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, cast it without paying its mana cost.
definitions.vanishing: This permanent enters with N time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, sacrifice it.
definitions.absorb: If this creature would be dealt damage, prevent N of that damage.
definitions.aura swap: Pay the aura swap cost: Exchange this Aura with an Aura card in your hand.
definitions.delve: Each card you exile from your graveyard while casting this spell pays for 1 mana.
definitions.fortify: Attach this Fortification to target land you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
definitions.frenzy: Whenever this creature attacks and isn't blocked, it gets +N/+0 until end of turn.
definitions.gravestorm: When you cast this spell, copy it for each permanent put into a graveyard this turn.
definitions.poisonous: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player gets N poison counters.
definitions.transfigure: Pay the transfigure cost and sacrifice this creature: Search your library for a creature card with the same converted mana cost as this creature, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
definitions.champion: When this enters, sacrifice it unless you exile another creature you control of the stated type. When this leaves, return that card to the battlefield.
definitions.changeling: This card is every creature type at all times.
definitions.evoke: You may cast this spell for its evoke cost. If you do, it's sacrificed when it enters.
definitions.hideaway: When this permanent enters, look at the top N cards of your library, exile one face down, then put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
definitions.prowl: You may cast this for its prowl cost if you dealt combat damage to a player this turn with a creature of the stated type.
definitions.reinforce: Pay the reinforce cost and discard this card: Put N +1/+1 counters on target creature.
definitions.conspire: As you cast this spell, you may tap two untapped creatures you control that share a color with it. When you do, copy it and you may choose a new target for the copy.
definitions.persist: When this creature dies, if it had no -1/-1 counters on it, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a -1/-1 counter on it.
definitions.wither: This deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters.
definitions.retrace: You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a land card in addition to paying its other costs.
definitions.devour: As this creature enters, you may sacrifice any number of creatures of the stated type. This creature enters with twice that many +1/+1 counters on it.
definitions.exalted: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
definitions.unearth: Pay the unearth cost: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step or if it would leave the battlefield.
definitions.cascade: When you cast this spell, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card that costs less. You may cast it without paying its mana cost. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
definitions.annihilator: Whenever this creature attacks, defending player sacrifices N permanents.
definitions.level up: Pay the level up cost: Put a level counter on this. Activate only as a sorcery.
definitions.rebound: If you cast this spell from your hand, exile it as it resolves. At the beginning of your next upkeep, you may cast this card from exile without paying its mana cost.
definitions.totem armor: If enchanted permanent would be destroyed, instead remove all damage from it and destroy this Aura.
definitions.infect: This creature deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters and to players in the form of poison counters.
definitions.battle cry: Whenever this creature attacks, each other attacking creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
definitions.living weapon: When this Equipment enters, create a 0/0 black Germ creature token, then attach this to it.
definitions.undying: When this creature dies, if it had no +1/+1 counters on it, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
definitions.miracle: You may cast this card for its miracle cost when you draw it if it's the first card you drew this turn.
definitions.soulbond: You may pair this creature with another unpaired creature when either enters. They remain paired for as long as you control both.
definitions.overload: You may cast this spell for its overload cost. If you do, change its text by replacing all instances of 'target' with 'each'.
definitions.scavenge: Pay the scavenge cost and exile this card from your graveyard: Put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to this card's power on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
definitions.unleash: You may have this creature enter with a +1/+1 counter on it. It can't block as long as it has a +1/+1 counter on it.
definitions.cipher: Then you may exile this spell card encoded on a creature you control. Whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player, its controller may cast a copy of the encoded card without paying its mana cost.
definitions.evolve: Whenever a creature enters under your control, if that creature has greater power or toughness than this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
definitions.extort: Whenever you cast a spell, you may pay White or Black mana. If you do, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain that much life.
definitions.fuse: You may cast one or both halves of this card from your hand.
definitions.bestow: If you cast this card for its bestow cost, it's an Aura spell with enchant creature. It becomes a creature again if it's not attached to a creature.
definitions.tribute: As this creature enters, an opponent of your choice may put N +1/+1 counters on it. If that player doesn't, [effect].
definitions.dethrone: Whenever this creature attacks the player with the most life or tied for most life, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
definitions.hidden agenda: Start the game with this conspiracy face down in the command zone and secretly name a card. You may turn this face up any time and reveal the named card.
definitions.outlast: Pay the outlast cost and tap this creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery.
definitions.dash: You may cast this spell for its dash cost. If you do, it gains haste, and it's returned from the battlefield to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.
definitions.exploit: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature.
definitions.renown: When this creature deals combat damage to a player, if it isn't renowned, put N +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes renowned.
definitions.awaken: If you cast this spell for its awaken cost, also put N +1/+1 counters on target land you control and it becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste. It's still a land.
definitions.ingest: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player exiles the top card of their library.
definitions.myriad: Whenever this creature attacks, for each opponent other than defending player, you may create a token that's a copy of this creature that's tapped and attacking that player or a planeswalker they control.
definitions.surge: You may cast this spell for its surge cost if you or a teammate has cast another spell this turn.
definitions.skulk: This creature can't be blocked by creatures with greater power.
definitions.emerge: You may cast this spell by sacrificing a creature and paying the emerge cost reduced by that creature's converted mana cost.
definitions.escalate: Pay the escalate cost for each mode chosen beyond the first.
definitions.meld: Exile this card and the stated card. They meld together into the stated card.
definitions.crew: Tap any number of creatures you control with total power N or more: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
definitions.fabricate: When this creature enters, put N +1/+1 counters on it or create N 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature tokens.
definitions.partner: You can have two commanders if both have partner.
definitions.undaunted: This spell costs 1 less to cast for each opponent you have.
definitions.improvise: Each artifact you tap while casting this spell pays for 1 mana.
definitions.aftermath: Cast this spell only from your graveyard. Then exile it.
definitions.embalm: Pay the embalm cost and exile this card from your graveyard: Create a token that's a copy of this card, except it's a white Zombie and has no mana cost.
definitions.eternalize: Pay the eternalize cost and exile this card from your graveyard: Create a token that's a copy of this card, except it's black, is 4/4, is a Zombie in addition to its other types, and has no mana cost.
definitions.afflict: Whenever this creature becomes blocked, defending player loses N life.
definitions.ascend: If you control ten or more permanents, you get the city's blessing for the rest of the game.
definitions.assist: Another player can pay up to the generic mana in this spell's cost.
definitions.jump-start: You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a card in addition to paying its other costs. Then exile this card.
definitions.mentor: Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target attacking creature with lesser power.
definitions.afterlife: When this creature dies, create N 1/1 white and black Spirit creature tokens with flying.
definitions.spectacle: You may cast this spell for its spectacle cost rather than its mana cost if an opponent lost life this turn.
definitions.riot: This creature enters with your choice of a +1/+1 counter or haste.
definitions.adapt: If this creature has no +1/+1 counters on it, put N +1/+1 counters on it.
definitions.amass: Put N +1/+1 counters on an Army you control. If you don't control one, create a 0/0 black Zombie Army creature token first.
definitions.escape: You may cast this card from your graveyard for its escape cost.
definitions.companion: If this card is your chosen companion, you may put it into your hand from outside the game for 3 mana as a sorcery.
definitions.mutate: If you cast this spell for its mutate cost, put it over or under target non-Human creature you own. They mutate into the creature on top plus all abilities from under it.
definitions.encore: Pay the encore cost and exile this card from your graveyard: For each opponent, create a token copy that attacks that opponent this turn if able. They gain haste. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.
definitions.boast: Activate this ability only if this creature attacked this turn and only once each turn.
definitions.foretell: Pay 2 mana and exile this card from your hand face down: Cast it on a later turn for its foretell cost.
definitions.demonstrate: When you cast this spell, you may copy it. If you do, choose an opponent to also copy it.
definitions.daybound: If a player casts no spells during their own turn, it becomes night next turn.
definitions.nightbound: If a player casts at least two spells during their own turn, it becomes day next turn.
definitions.disturb: You may cast this card from your graveyard transformed for its disturb cost.
definitions.decayed: This creature can't block. When it attacks, sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
definitions.cleave: You may cast this spell for its cleave cost. If you do, remove the words in square brackets.
definitions.training: Whenever this creature attacks with another creature with greater power, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
definitions.compleated: This planeswalker can be cast by paying 2 life instead of a colored mana pip. If you do, it enters with two fewer loyalty counters.
definitions.reconfigure: Pay the reconfigure cost: Attach to target creature you control or unattach. Activate only as a sorcery.
definitions.blitz: If you cast this spell for its blitz cost, it gains haste and 'When this creature dies, draw a card.' Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
definitions.casualty: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may sacrifice a creature with power N or greater. If you do, copy this spell.
definitions.enlist: As this creature attacks, you may tap a nonattacking creature you control without summoning sickness. If you do, add its power to this creature's until end of turn.
definitions.read ahead: Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add a lore counter during your precombat main phase. Sacrifice after chapter III.
definitions.ravenous: This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it. If X is 5 or more, draw a card when it enters.
definitions.squad: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may pay the squad cost any number of times. If you paid it N times, create N tokens that are copies of this creature when it enters.
definitions.prototype: You may cast this spell with different base power, toughness, and mana cost. It keeps its abilities.
definitions.living metal: As long as it's your turn, this Vehicle is also a creature.
definitions.for mirrodin: When this Equipment enters, create a 2/2 red Rebel creature token, then attach this Equipment to it.
definitions.toxic: Players dealt combat damage by this creature also get N poison counters.
definitions.corrupted: Activate only if an opponent has three or more poison counters.
definitions.backup: When this creature enters, put N +1/+1 counters on target creature. If that's another creature, it gains the following abilities until end of turn.
definitions.battles: Battles must be attacked to remove defense counters. When the last is removed, exile it and cast the back face.
definitions.plot: Pay the plot cost and exile this card: Cast it on a later turn without paying its mana cost. Plot only as a sorcery.
definitions.saddle: Tap any number of other creatures you control with total power N or more: This Mount becomes saddled until end of turn. Saddle only as a sorcery.
definitions.offspring: Pay the offspring cost as an additional cost. If you do, when this creature enters, create a 1/1 token copy of it.
definitions.impending: If cast for its impending cost, it's not a creature. Put N time counters on it. At the start of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, it becomes a creature.
definitions.delineate: When this spell resolves, if it was cast for its delineate cost, draw a card.
definitions.expend: Expend N — [Effect that triggers when you've spent N or more mana on spells this turn]

dork.description: A creature that costs 1 mana and taps to produce mana

mana rock.description: An artifact that produces mana, usually costing 0-2 mana

wrath.description: A spell that destroys or exiles all creatures

board wipe.description: A spell that destroys or exiles all permanents of a given type

tutor.description: A spell that searches your library for a specific card

counterspell.description: An instant that counters a spell on the stack

ramp.description: Cards that accelerate your mana production beyond the normal one land per turn

draw.description: Cards that let you draw additional cards beyond your normal draw

removal.description: Spells that destroy, exile, or otherwise deal with a specific permanent

finisher.description: A card that ends the game when it resolves or enters the battlefield

hate piece.description: A card specifically designed to shut down a common strategy or mechanic

stax.description: Cards that tax or restrict opponents' actions, slowing the game down

combo piece.description: A card that forms part of a two or more card combination that wins the game or generates overwhelming advantage

value engine.description: A permanent that generates continuous card advantage or resources over multiple turns

beater.description: A large creature whose primary purpose is to deal combat damage

voltron.description: A strategy focused on making one creature extremely powerful through Equipment, Auras, or counters

aristocrats.description: A strategy that revolves around sacrificing creatures for value

reanimator.description: A strategy that puts large creatures into the graveyard and returns them to the battlefield

spellslinger.description: A strategy focused on casting many instants and sorceries for value

tokens.description: A strategy that creates many creature tokens to overwhelm opponents

stompy.description: A strategy focused on playing large creatures and attacking
